name: avalon
summary: Avalon showcases a sculptural silhouette entirely upholstered in soft textile, elevated by slender stainless steel legs finished in a warm brushed copper. The harmony of tactile richness and metallic precision offers a contemporary expression of refined elegance. 69x93x68
